postTitle: Refinancing: When to Refinance and When to Wait
topic: On a small balance, a good rate drop can still take years to pay for itself

assumptions.notes: Blog: a €50,000 mortgage refinanced from 4% to 3% lowers the monthly payment by only about €25 to €30; with €2,500 of closing costs, break even is around seven to eight years. Compared with the blog's main example: €4,000 costs, €200 a month, month 20. Bar values in months: 20 and about 90 (7.5 years, shown as 7 to 8 years).

barStory.basis: Months to win back the costs, illustrative
barStory.disclosure: Illustrative. Payment savings depend on the remaining term.

hookVariants.narration: Your mortgage is down to fifty thousand euros. Is a rate one point lower worth refinancing?

beats.narration: On a larger loan, four thousand of costs and two hundred a month saved breaks even in month twenty.
On fifty thousand, one point lower saves about twenty five to thirty euros a month. Two and a half thousand of costs takes seven to eight years.
Same check, smaller balance: costs divided by the monthly saving.
